hypothesis: The replication error is associated with sparse support in physical afterstate feature space within a known scenario, rather than an unseen scenario axis.
forbidden_training_data: Every discovery and late row from both sealed evaluation runs.
development_change: Collect additional independent mid/late H3 roots under the existing eight-condition matrix with declared simulator environment seeds, emphasizing distinct afterstates rather than increasing H3 depth.
trajectory_independence_contract: Every collection records its simulator environment seed in both the dataset manifest and replay contract. Different seeds are necessary but not sufficient: model-visible packed and packed-plus-visible afterstate delta signatures must also be unique.

development_collection_result.reason: Different environment seeds produced many byte-distinct teacher rows but repeated the exact model-visible afterstate deltas across runs.

stream_variant_followup.rationale: Change the item stream visible to the policy while holding the simulator seed, scenario matrix, H3 depth, branch factor, and model fixed.

admission_gate.signature: exact concatenation of packed and packed-plus-visible model feature deltas

stream_variant_followup.decision: Run the collection independence audit before any model evaluation. If the gate fails, do not add these rows to training or alter the threshold.

partial_collection_recovery_contract.admission_unit: An individual graph artifact that completed strict root reconstruction and graph validation.
partial_collection_recovery_contract.exclusion_rule: Exclude only missing or failed graphs by workflow step status; never inspect continuation labels to select a graph.
partial_collection_recovery_contract.coverage_rule: The union must include all eight base scenario labels and report every missing variant-scenario cell.
partial_collection_recovery_contract.model_rule: Do not fit or score a model unless graph-level recovery passes coverage and independence gates. A recovered collection does not change the FAIL status of either source workflow run.

excluded: dual-empty step 15: strict root reconstruction mismatch

stream_variant_result.recovery_note: Only graph artifacts that had already completed strict root reconstruction and graph validation were admitted. Labels were not used for admission, and failed workflow runs remain failed.

model_contract.predictor: unchanged consensus of fixed-L2 packed-only and packed-plus-visible no-intercept ridges
model_contract.support_measure: standardized nearest discovery-training afterstate distance for both feature blocks
model_contract.candidate_support_threshold: training-only leave-one-out p95 for each feature block
model_contract.selection_rule: consensus agreement and both support distances at or below threshold

development_acceptance.comparison: must not make more supported-row errors than the unchanged ungated consensus or action geometry

development_model_result.decision: Do not refreeze, confirm, shadow, or move to H5. Test teacher-label stability under wider H3 branching before adding model capacity.

branch_width_followup.hypothesis: Some residual representation errors are caused by B2 optimistic continuation labels being under-sampled, rather than by an insufficient state representation alone.
branch_width_followup.intervention: Rebuild the erroneous stream-variant roots at H3/B3 while holding stream, root snapshot, environment seed, simulator, score axes, and reconstruction tolerance fixed.
branch_width_followup.primary_measure: Whether the directional fill_score_proxy relation for each matched sibling pair agrees between B2 and B3.
branch_width_followup.admission: Every B3 graph must pass the existing strict root reconstruction and graph validation contracts; no tolerance changes and no label-conditioned exclusions.
branch_width_followup.decision_rule: If any tested directional relation changes, treat B2 label stability as unresolved and expand branch-width coverage before model work. If all relations are stable, retain H3/B2 labels and investigate richer state interactions without opening sealed confirmation data.

result.interpretation: Widening B2 to B3 changed which candidate paths survive selection, so three error rows cannot be treated as fixed-label examples under the wider search. The one directly comparable pair retained its lower-afterstate-better relation.

forced_pair_followup.hypothesis: The four representation errors can be evaluated as stable state-value teachers when their original parent item path and sibling item pair are preserved while only the continuation width is expanded.
forced_pair_followup.intervention: At each specified path, retain the current provider's best physical candidate for each preregistered item, force those items into the H3/B3 branch set, and fill remaining width by the unchanged provider ranking.
invariants: The current provider still generates each forced candidate; a missing item fails the graph.
Horizon remains 3, branch factor remains 3, environment seed remains 42, and strict replay tolerance is unchanged.
No stored B2 command coordinates are injected and no continuation label is inspected during graph construction.
forced_pair_followup.primary_gate: All four matched sibling relations must be directly comparable and stable between B2 and forced-pair B3 before model development resumes.
forced_pair_followup.agent_gate: Even a passing teacher-stability result is not a score-improving agent. A candidate must later beat the incumbent on a fresh physical trajectory experiment under a frozen selection rule.

result.decision: Retire H3/B2 directional labels as a training standard. Collect new development and variant-held-out teachers directly at H3/B3 before fitting another agent.

h3_b3_teacher_migration.label_standard: H3/B3 optimistic continuation from physically reconstructed afterstates
h3_b3_teacher_migration.reason: Forced-pair evidence shows that two of four apparent B2 model errors become equal when continuation width grows.
collection_order: Build B3 discovery teachers for the three independent stream variants without sealed confirmation data.
Audit model-visible signature independence and directional label counts.
Hold out each stream variant in full for model selection.
Freeze a candidate only if directional coverage is at least 75%, errors are zero, and it beats action geometry.
Only then run a fresh physical trajectory comparison against the incumbent.
h3_b3_teacher_migration.stop_rule: Do not relabel B2 rows post hoc, mix B2 and B3 directional targets, or describe a teacher-classification improvement as expected competition-score gain.

result.reason: B3 produces multiple pair rows per parent; repeated model-visible signatures reduce the raw unique fraction even though no signature has conflicting labels.

signature_unit_holdout.unit: One exact packed plus packed-visible afterstate-delta signature with one directional fill relation.
signature_unit_holdout.deduplication_rule: Collapse repeated signatures to one unit only when every row has the same relation. Any conflicting relation fails the experiment. Do not weight a signature by its row multiplicity.
signature_unit_holdout.holdout_generation: Rotate bundled case 000 item order left by seven while preserving stable item identities; environment seed 42; eight-condition H3/B3 matrix.
signature_unit_holdout.model_selection: Choose among the already-declared representation audit families using whole-development-stream leave-one-out accuracy on signature units only.
signature_unit_holdout.acceptance: Freeze only a unique best representation with zero development signature errors. The new rotate-000-7 holdout must then have at least 12 directional late signatures, zero signature conflicts, at least 75% supported coverage, zero supported errors, and outperform action geometry on covered units.
signature_unit_holdout.score_claim: Passing this gate creates an agent candidate worth physical trajectory testing; it does not itself establish competition-score gain.

symmetric_continuation_support.rule: At least two continuation values must exist for each afterstate.

holdout_result.known_execution_status_only: single-preloaded failed strict root reconstruction before cancellation
holdout_result.decision: Keep rotate-000-7 sealed; do not score it or repurpose it for development.

continuation_support_followup.hypothesis: The 17/18 development result is limited by sparse and asymmetric optimistic-continuation support, not by a missing generic nonlinear interaction.
continuation_support_followup.stream_definition: Rotate bundled case 001 left by five while preserving stable item identities; environment seed 42; unchanged eight-condition H3/B3 matrix.
continuation_support_followup.admission: Use all graphs that pass strict root reconstruction and graph validation, without label-conditioned exclusions. Keep rotate-000-7 sealed.
continuation_support_followup.minimum_new_support: At least six new directional late signature units with at least two continuation values on both afterstates.
continuation_support_followup.model_rule: Re-run whole-stream leave-one-out across all four development streams using the already-declared representations. Do not add representations after labels are inspected.
continuation_support_followup.acceptance: Freeze only a unique best model with zero errors, at least 12 supported late units, and at least 75% symmetric-continuation-support coverage. Do not lower either threshold.
continuation_support_followup.negative_controls: The exploratory outer-product, grid-by-action-summary, squared-grid, squared-action, and ridge-strength changes did not exceed 17/18 and are not new declared candidates. Mean, median, and minimum continuation aggregation also failed to produce a zero-error consistent target.

confirmation_contract: After development acceptance, freeze once and evaluate on one later physical matrix generated after the freeze commit. The new confirmation must independently meet at least 75% coverage and zero errors.
stop_conditions: Do not reinterpret either sealed run as confirmation after feature or threshold changes.
Do not increase to H5 until the new independent confirmation passes.
Do not enable shadow or live selection from retrospective or pooled accuracy.
